title: Fem Technology Absolutely Feature Complete
description: Close every documented v0/v1/v2 deferral in the FEM technology (fem/core, fem/2d, fem/3d, fem-plugin) so it is absolutely feature complete, mirroring the NORM-TECHNOLOGY-ABSOLUTELY-FEATURE-COMPLETE workflow: nodal-averaged cross-element stress smoothing, mass()/geometric_stiffness()/equivalent_nodal_loads() for all elements (Tri3Cst, Tri6Lst, Quad4, Quad8, Tet4, Hex8, PlateDkt, ShellFacet3, Bar2, Bar3), fem_3d solid/continuum regions (FemSolid schema, ops, mesh preview, area pressure loads) mirroring fem_2d's regions, plugin polish (2D reaction labels, 3D oriented member prisms, 3D solid rendering + stress contours, 3D captions), a small framework/renderer/react vertex-color passthrough fix, and nx/project.json/script.ts/launch.json tooling for fem/core/rs and fem/plugin/rs which currently have none. Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/make-fem-aboslutely-feature-cached-crane.md.
summary:
Fixed the FEM apps' end-to-end runtime experience — the user reported both apps rendering nothing at boot ("Analysis error: model has no nodes" in 3D). Root cause: fem was the only example-bearing plugin that never handled the shell's `setActiveExample` boot dispatch, so both apps stayed on their empty initial projection forever.

**P1 (root cause)**: added a `SetDocument` op (with true inverse and a diff short-circuit/absorb-wholesale-wins rule) to `Fem2dOp`/`Fem3dOp`, mirroring `gis/plugin/rs`'s established pattern for granular-op documents that also need whole-document replacement. Wired a `setActiveExample` handler in both `Fem2dPlayApp`/`Fem3dPlayApp` that parses the embedded example JSON and emits `SetDocument`, registered as an `.operation` (not a view action — the framework rejects ops from view/shell actions) with a select arg and EN/DE labels.

**P2**: rebuilt both example fixtures, which previously didn't actually exercise the features they were meant to showcase (the 2D region carried no load at all; the 3D pressure case wasn't the default view and was excluded from the ULS combination; neither had self-weight; buckling wasn't physically illustrative). New fixtures: 2D gets an L-frame (slender column + 2-segment beam) with a loaded slab region, self-weight, mixed load kinds in one case, and a column in real axial compression for buckling; 3D gets a column + cantilever with a loaded solid, same treatment. Updated every fixture-coupled test (node/element counts, case ids, added nodal-von-Mises and buckling-factor assertions).

**P3**: static displacement views now honor `doc.analysis.deformation_scale` (previously hardcoded `DEFORM_SCALE_2D=500`/`DEFORM_SCALE_3D=200` ignored it entirely — editing the setting from the UI did nothing). Modal/buckling mode shapes — which are mass/Kg-orthonormalized and thus have arbitrary physical magnitude — now get a new `normalize_mode_shape` (rescale to unit peak displacement) and are drawn at `MODE_SHAPE_AMPLITUDE_RATIO (0.1) × model extent`, a deterministic amplitude independent of the eigensolver's normalization.

**P4**: added the full missing action set to both apps — `addRegion`(2D)/`addSolid`(3D), `addAreaLoad`, `addMemberUdl` (new in 3D), `addLoadCase`, `addCombination`, `setSelfWeight`, `setAnalysisSettings`, plus extended `removeSelection` to cover regions/solids/combinations. Every documented feature (meshed regions/solids, area loads, self-weight, combinations, analysis settings) is now reachable from the UI, not just from example JSON. Extracted shared `fem2d_resolve_load_case`/`fem3d_resolve_load_case` helpers and added an optional `caseId` arg to existing load actions.

**P5**: fixed the dev hot-swap watcher (`framework/product/os/dev/script.ts`), which only watched a plugin's own crate directory — edits to dependency crates (`fem/2d/rs`, `fem/3d/rs`, `fem/core/rs`) or example fixture JSON never triggered a rebuild. New `pluginWatchRoot` helper widens the watch to the top-level app directory for non-framework-hosted plugin crates.

Verified: 189/189 tests passing across fem_core(92)/fem_2d(33)/fem_3d(31)/fem-plugin(33), zero warnings. Live browser verification via `fem2d-react-dev`/`fem3d-react-dev`: 2D app confirmed fully working end-to-end (visible deformed shape, banded von Mises contour with legend, reaction labels, moment diagram, correct modal caption "Mode 1: 451.346 Hz" with well-scaled shape); 3D app confirmed via a clean screenshot (oriented column member, grid) and repeated DOM captures of the "Case: dead" caption (proving the solve→render pipeline succeeds) — some 3D screenshots were disrupted by an unrelated concurrent session's active hot-reload churn on shared frontend files (`framework/renderer/react/index.tsx`), not a regression from this work.

Files touched: fem/2d/rs/lib.rs, fem/3d/rs/lib.rs, fem/plugin/rs/lib.rs, fem/2d/example/default.fem2d.json, fem/3d/example/default.fem3d.json, framework/product/os/dev/script.ts, .repo/🎫/26/07/19/FEM-TECHNOLOGY-ABSOLUTELY-FEATURE-COMPLETE/part-checklist.md.
